title: Cork Twisters
subtitle: Classic tongue twisters — now on hard mode
description: Tongue twisters are already a challenge, but doing them with a cork between your teeth takes articulation to a whole new level. Your tongue must work with precision while your jaw and lips compensate for the restriction.
tip: Go slowly at first — speed is not the goal, clarity is. The cork will slip if you rush and tense up.
